description: Plugin package release record. EXPERIMENTAL: this NSID is part of the experimental phase of the EmDash plugin registry. The stable namespace target is com.emdashcms.package.release.

main.description: A specific versioned release of a plugin package. The record key encodes both the parent package's slug and the version, separated by ':'. A release's AT URI looks like at://did:plc:abc123/com.emdashcms.experimental.package.release/gallery-plugin:1.2.0. A release at a given version cannot be modified or replaced once published.

package.description: Slug of the parent package profile in the same repository. MUST match the rkey of an existing package profile record. Combined with the publisher DID, the parent profile's AT URI is at://<publisher-did>/com.emdashcms.experimental.package.profile/<package>. Aggregators MUST reject release records whose package field does not resolve to a profile in the same repository.

version.description: Version, conforming to a subset of semver 2.0 (build metadata '+...' is disallowed because atproto record keys cannot represent it). MUST equal the post-':' portion of the rkey byte-for-byte. Composed only of characters allowed in atproto record keys: ASCII letters, digits, '.', and '-'. Note that while atproto rkeys also permit '_' and '~', semver disallows them in version strings, so they MUST NOT appear here.

artifacts.description: Map of artifact type to artifact object. MUST have at least one entry. The 'package' entry (installable bundle) is required.

provides.description: Capabilities the package provides. Map of capability type to string or list of strings.

requires.description: Dependencies. Map of 'env:*' keys (extension-defined environment requirements) or package DIDs to version constraint strings. EmDash uses 'env:emdash' and 'env:astro'.

suggests.description: Optional packages that may be installed alongside. Same shape as requires.

auth.description: Authentication requirements for gated artifacts. No authentication variants are currently defined.

repo.description: AT URI or HTTPS URL of the source repository for this release.

extensions.description: Open-union container for extension data, keyed by NSID. Each value is an embedded record carrying its own $type discriminator. Releases of type emdash-plugin MUST include a com.emdashcms.experimental.package.releaseExtension entry here.

artifacts.description: Map of artifact-type-name to artifact. Common artifact-type keys are 'package' (the installable bundle, REQUIRED), 'icon', 'screenshots' (a list), and 'banner'. Custom types use an 'x-' prefix and pass through as unrecognised fields.

screenshots.description: Ordered screenshot gallery for the plugin's detail page.

blob.description: Artifact bytes stored as a blob in the publisher's PDS.

id.description: Unique ID within the artifact type.

contentType.description: MIME type of the artifact, per RFC6838.

requiresAuth.description: Whether the artifact requires authentication to access.

releaseAsset.description: Whether the URL points to a platform release asset rather than a directly-served file. When true, clients MUST send 'Accept: application/octet-stream' when downloading.

url.description: URL where the artifact can be downloaded.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature of the artifact. EmDash clients do not require it because integrity is proven through the atproto MST signature over the record's checksum.

checksum.description: Lowercase base32 multibase-encoded sha2-256 multihash of the artifact bytes (multihash code 0x12). EmDash clients reject unsupported hash functions rather than skipping verification.

width.description: Pixel width, for image artifacts (icon, screenshot, banner).

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag for localised artifacts (icon, screenshot).

imageArtifact.description: A raster image artifact for a plugin listing.

blob.description: Image bytes stored as a blob in the publisher's PDS.

sbom.description: Software bill of materials reference. EmDash plugins SHOULD include sbom for CRA-readiness; clients MUST NOT refuse install solely because sbom is absent.

url.description: URL where the SBOM document can be fetched.

checksum.description: Multibase-encoded multihash of the SBOM document, in the same format as artifact checksums.
